section_description: The GoreeCloud Suite is the first-party application layer of GoreeCloud: user-facing software, client applications, platform services, operations tools, developer systems, and intelligence experiences that share GoreeCloud design, privacy, security, resilience, and coordination contracts.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Notes
applications.description: Self-hosted note-taking, knowledge-management, and productivity application for durable personal and shared knowledge.
applications.role: Full notes and knowledge-management workspace.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Memos
applications.description: Lightweight Markdown-native quick-note capture for fast notes when a full knowledge workspace is unnecessary.
applications.role: Focused quick-capture companion to GoreeCloud Notes.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Tasks
applications.description: Privacy-first multi-user task and project-management application for personal, family, collaborative, and operational work.
applications.role: Task, project, and work-tracking platform.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Calendar
applications.description: Native GoreeCloud calendar application designed around standards-based scheduling and portable calendar data.
applications.role: User-facing calendar application and CalDAV presentation layer.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Contacts
applications.description: Privacy-first contact-management application with portable address-book data and standards-based interoperability.
applications.role: User-facing contacts application and CardDAV presentation layer.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Documents
applications.description: First-party intelligent document-management platform for capture, OCR, search, organization, automation, collaboration, and preservation.
applications.role: Document lifecycle, search, workflow, collaboration, and archival authority.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Drive
applications.description: First-party private multi-user cloud file storage, sharing, collaboration, and version-history application.
applications.role: Cloud file-storage and file-management platform.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Sync
applications.description: Privacy-first multi-user file synchronization, nearby transfer, and encrypted sharing platform.
applications.role: Synchronization and secure-transfer platform.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Photos
applications.description: Cloud photo and family-media platform using an Immich-derived foundation with a controlled fork-to-native transition.
applications.role: Cloud photo library, organization, preservation, and sharing platform.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Gallery
applications.description: Offline-first Android gallery for browsing and managing device-local photos and media.
applications.role: Local photo and media gallery client.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Music
applications.description: Original multi-user GoreeCloud music service and application for privately managed music libraries.
applications.role: First-party music library and playback service.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Video
applications.description: Private multi-user video platform using a Jellyfin-derived foundation with a controlled fork-to-native transition.
applications.role: Video library, playback, streaming, and family-media service.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Bookmarks
applications.description: Self-hosted bookmark, reading, annotation, collection, and web-preservation platform.
applications.role: Bookmark management, read-later, library, and web-preservation authority.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Mail
applications.description: Native GoreeCloud front-end mail application and provider-integration project; GoreeCloud does not operate a mail server.
applications.role: First-party mail client and provider-integration layer.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Messenger
applications.description: Native messaging and calling with GoreeCloud Data messaging, explicit transport identity, encryption boundaries, groups, and calling foundations.
applications.role: First-party private messaging and calling application.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Search
applications.description: GoreeCloud-maintained private search and metasearch gateway for web discovery, browser search, research, and AI-assisted workflows.
applications.role: Current GoreeCloud search, discovery, and AI-research gateway.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Browser
applications.description: First-party browser application with GoreeCloud-owned product layers and a replaceable mature rendering-engine foundation.
applications.role: Primary GoreeCloud web browser and service-integration gateway.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Feed
applications.description: Private multi-user RSS experience across web, Linux desktop, and Android with FreshRSS as the current backend foundation.
applications.role: First-party feed-reading and subscription client layer.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Location
applications.description: Original privacy-first multi-user location and tracking platform built around explicit access boundaries.
applications.role: Location application and location-data service.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Keyboard
applications.description: GoreeCloud-maintained Android keyboard with first-party Quill typing, editing, privacy, and intelligent-input capability families.
applications.role: Android input method and productivity client.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Launcher
applications.description: Original GoreeCloud-owned Android home-screen launcher designed for privacy-first device navigation and GoreeCloud integration.
applications.role: Android launcher and device-entry experience.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Terminal
applications.description: GoreeCloud-maintained Linux terminal derived from Ptyxis with a controlled fork-to-native evolution path.
applications.role: Primary GoreeCloud Linux terminal application.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Manager
applications.description: Native administration and operations console for GoreeCloud infrastructure, services, and protection systems.
applications.role: Central management and operations console.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Identity
applications.description: GoreeCloud-maintained identity and single sign-on project based initially on authentik.
applications.role: Identity, authentication, account, and authorization authority under development.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Vault
applications.description: First-party credential, passkey, secret, and protected-authentication experience backed by GoreeCloud-controlled vault services.
applications.role: Protected credential and authentication-material management.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Backup
applications.description: GoreeCloud-maintained backup project based initially on Kopia with recovery and portability requirements kept explicit.
applications.role: Future GoreeCloud backup authority; existing recovery systems remain authoritative until replacement is proven.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Network
applications.description: GoreeCloud private-network project based initially on NetBird with a controlled transition toward a GoreeCloud-owned platform boundary.
applications.role: Private networking, device connectivity, and network-policy platform.

applications.name: GoreeCloud DNS
applications.description: GoreeCloud DNS filtering project derived from AdGuard Home with recursive resolution kept as a separate responsibility.
applications.role: DNS filtering, policy, and GoreeCloud DNS integration layer.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Gateway
applications.description: Native GoreeCloud reverse proxy, HTTPS gateway, ingress controller, certificate manager, and service-publication platform.
applications.role: Controlled HTTPS ingress, routing, certificate, and publication authority.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Notify
applications.description: GoreeCloud-native notification and alert service being validated as the long-term replacement for the current ntfy production service.
applications.role: Centralized first-party application and infrastructure notification authority after controlled acceptance.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Monitor
applications.description: Original monitoring application for availability, endpoint health, heartbeats, certificates, incidents, outages, and recovery.
applications.role: Long-term GoreeCloud availability-monitoring authority after controlled validation and cutover.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Changelogs
applications.description: Native historical change-ledger application for recording, organizing, and reviewing GoreeCloud changes over time.
applications.role: Historical change-management and change-ledger platform.

applications.name: GoreeCloud AI
applications.description: First-party conversational AI and local-model interface designed around Ollama, Glaze UI, GoreeCloud Search, and GoreeCloud service integrations.
applications.role: Private AI workspace and governed model, knowledge, and tool-interaction layer.

applications.name: GoreeCloud Code
applications.description: First-party developer and source-control platform for repositories, collaboration, CI/CD, packages, security, and AI-assisted development.
applications.role: GoreeCloud developer platform; Forgejo is the initial replaceable infrastructure foundation.
